text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 5. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 6. Postgraduate school transcript 7. Resume Written in Chinese or in English
